researchRecords.company: DACH B2B tech and SaaS decision-makers

scoreMapping.intentScore: 0.82 from buyers influenced by creator content
scoreMapping.fitScore: 0.94 from trust priority among B2B marketers

evidence: 94% of B2B marketers say trust is key to success.
78% of B2B marketers use video.
82% of B2B buyers say creator content influences buying decisions.
59% of B2B buyers consume creator content on LinkedIn.
79% engage with creator content at least monthly.

researchRecords.notes: LinkedIn and creator-led video are high-signal trust channels for B2B decision-makers in markets that include Germany.
researchRecords.title: Marketing and revenue leaders

researchRecords.company: Brazil B2B tech and SaaS decision-makers

scoreMapping.intentScore: 0.82 from buyers influenced by creator content
scoreMapping.fitScore: 0.94 from trust priority among B2B marketers

evidence: Benchmark sample included Brazil and Germany.
94% trust priority.
82% creator influence on purchase.
59% creator-content consumption on LinkedIn.

researchRecords.notes: The same LinkedIn benchmark included Brazil, making trust-first creator and video outreach relevant for localized PT-BR campaigns.
researchRecords.title: Marketing and revenue leaders

researchRecords.company: Global B2B software buyers in active review/comparison mode

evidence: 73% of organic traffic visited reviews, pricing details, and competitive comparisons.
56% of buyers planned to make a purchase within the next three months.
Top three buyer resources: product demos, prior experience, and user reviews.

scoreMapping.recencyScore: 0.54 from user reviews being a top-three consulted resource
scoreMapping.intentScore: 0.56 from buyers planning purchase within 3 months
scoreMapping.fitScore: 0.73 from share of high-intent review/pricing/comparison traffic

researchRecords.notes: High-intent buyers cluster around reviews, pricing, and comparison content; follow-up should route to proof-heavy assets rather than generic awareness copy.
researchRecords.title: High-intent software evaluators

researchRecords.company: Enterprise software buyers before shortlist formation

scoreMapping.recencyScore: 0.72 from buyers setting criteria before shortlist
scoreMapping.intentScore: 0.82 from buyers already having a top product in mind
scoreMapping.fitScore: 0.89 from enterprise buyers knowing the product before research

evidence: Average shortlist size was 2.6 products.
79% knew the product before research.
89% for enterprise buyers.
82% had a top product in mind when shortlisting.
72% determined criteria before making a shortlist.
77% used Google, 52% vendor website, 29% YouTube, 25% TrustRadius.

researchRecords.notes: Enterprise buyers need brand recall and self-serve proof before outreach; if you are not already known pre-research, shortlist odds are poor.
researchRecords.title: Enterprise buying committees

researchRecords.company: AI-adopting marketing teams with personalization pressure

evidence: 93.2% say personalized or segmented experiences led to more leads and purchases.
Only 65% say they have high-quality audience data.
Only 12.6% use hyper-personalization.
86.4% of marketing teams use AI in at least a few areas.
93.8% say lead quality improved over the past year.

scoreMapping.recencyScore: 0.864 from AI usage across marketing teams
scoreMapping.fitScore: 0.932 from personalized experiences driving leads and purchases

researchRecords.notes: Teams already using AI and under pressure to personalize are strong targets for localization and orchestration messaging, especially where audience-data quality is a known bottleneck.
researchRecords.title: Marketing operations and demand generation leaders

evidence: 17 languages each control at least 1% of global online GDP.

scoreMapping.fitScore: 0.17 from 17 languages controlling at least 1% each of online GDP

researchRecords.notes: CSA indicates digital opportunity is concentrated; language expansion should prioritize the limited set of languages controlling material shares of online GDP.
researchRecords.title: Localization and expansion planners
